run_meta_learning_experiment: run the Jaxline meta-learning experiment for functa using platform.main with the Experiment class
build_training_config: build a config object for meta-learning training with dataset, optimizer, and model settings via get_config
run_training_step: run a single training step that updates meta-learned init params using the Experiment step method
evaluate_model: evaluate the meta-learned model on a validation batch and log PSNR scalars via the Experiment evaluate method
fit_inner_loop_params: fit model parameters by running the MAML inner loop SGD steps on a single image via _inner_loop
